answer: A jade-beacon heartbeat bond stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 80 copper credits on one timber node. Each epoch the jade beacon sends a filer a fresh nonce; its timber node must answer in ten minutes. Auditors replay it on the jade table; late or reused burns the bond. First 42 copper credits, k-th 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 and lock 80,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented nodes fail: one key, one node. Honest agents pay 42 once.
